source.normalization: Original pieces have unit circumradius, so tetrahedron edge length is 1.6329931618554523; centers divided by this edge. Apply a proper rigid rotation to align ALL published dodecahedron outer vertices with the project canonical solid (normalized discrepancy 4.49e-15). Fit piece rotations to ALL source mesh vertices (maximum discrepancy 6.03e-16). Convert container circumradius into edge ratio R/(1.4012585384440737 * 1.6329931618554523). Add standard 1e-7 clearance without transferring discovery credit.
